images.title: Does it fit inside
images.purpose: Show that 48 is divisible by 12 because the primes of 12 sit inside the primes of 48.
images.composition: One long row of dots in the centre with a bracket under part of it, and the labels above and below.
images.exact_structure: One row of 5 dots evenly spaced and equal in size: the first 3 teal #0072B2, the last 2 amber #E69F00. A reddish purple #CC79A7 bracket under the first 3 dots only. Label above the row, label under the bracket, one line at the bottom. Exactly 5 dots, 1 bracket.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a bracket covering a different number of dots than 3
images.takeaway: If the primes of 12 are inside those of 48, then 48 is divisible by 12.
images.description: A row of five dots for 48 with a bracket around the first three dots that make 12.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the three dots under the bracket and say what they make.

image_decisions.why: Showing the smaller prime list inside the larger one is a picture idea; one image carries it.
